_comment: Counted-metrics ledger, family 'syscalls' (#2137). See copies.json for the pin rules.
title: Syscalls per relayed frame (libc wrappers, node B's link threads; futex not counted)
_counts: Every call node B's link threads make to the libc wrappers bench_peer_counts interposes: socket I/O (read, write, readv, writev, recv, recvfrom, recvmsg, recvmmsg, send, sendto, sendmsg, sendmmsg), waiting (poll, ppoll, select, pselect, epoll_wait, epoll_pwait, epoll_pwait2, epoll_ctl, eventfd_read, eventfd_write), connection setup and teardown (accept, accept4, connect, shutdown, close, setsockopt, getsockopt) and yielding or sleeping (sched_yield, nanosleep, clock_nanosleep). Not counted: futex, which glibc issues inline from pthread, where no wrapper sees it, and which an unprivileged process cannot count from the kernel (perf_event_paranoid 2). Widening the set from send/recv/poll to this one (#2171) moved no pinned row.
_toolchain: Copy and syscall counts follow the code, but which copies the compiler inlines does not, so a run on another toolchain is reported in warn mode and never turns CI red.
_band: 0.05 per frame: every pinned row read min = max except three 16 KiB rows at 11.00..11.01 (one extra poll in 200 frames). One more syscall per frame reads +1.00 and trips it.
_goal: #2136 states no syscall figure for WIDE, so those rows hold (no rise). MID: one doorbell per burst instead of one control message per frame per peer.

rows.basis: IDF httpd_req_new reads the first header byte, httpd_ws_recv_frame(req, 0) the second and the 4 B mask key, httpd_ws_recv_frame(req, len) the payload: 4 lwip_recv. The select wake is shared by a burst and not counted.
httpd_queue_work: sendto + recvfrom on the control socket (2), then httpd_ws_send_frame_async: 2 lwip_send (header, payload). Goal: one doorbell per burst (#2136 egress), leaving the 2 lwip_send.

_counted: The wrappers interposed are read, write, readv, writev, recv, recvfrom, recvmsg, send, sendto, sendmsg, poll, ppoll, select and epoll_wait (and the fortified _chk forms). A syscall outside that set (epoll_pwait, accept4, recvmmsg, futex, ...) is not counted: futex is a disclosed gap (the peer-cost study measured 0.00 per frame), and a link moving to an uncounted call would read as a fall here, so such a change must extend the wrapper set.
